additionalWorkLimitations: All 134 library TypeScript/TSX sources now have a full-file read in combined evidence. Type-only modules are counted as source, not claimed as emitted JS.
No linguistic certification or exhaustive UI-label/runtime mapping is claimed by reading translation catalogs.
Uncalled legacy exports were read but do not imply that payment or network branches are exposed by the funded build.
